title: Transient transfection of Creolimax fragrantissima using Lonza Nucleofector
author: Aleksandra Kozyczkowska
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r65d9g6
materials: Carefully & without creating bubbles In total 20-22ul

steps.title: Prepare cell culture
steps.instruction: Start a culture two days before transfection to ensure the culture is full of amoebas cells.

substeps.instruction: Combine 300ul of culture with 9ml of Marine Broth in a 25cm2 flask.

steps.title: Prepare cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Count the cells to reach 1.5E6 cells per condition.

substeps.instruction: If multiple conditions are used, pull the cells together to obtain a more visible pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in P3 buffer
steps.instruction: Add 20ul of P3 buffer (Lonza P3 PrimaryCell 4D-Nucleofector Kit S, Catalog# H3V4XP-5032) per condition.

substeps.instruction: Ensure cells are not kept in P3 buffer for too long.

steps.title: Add plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1-3 ug of a highly concentrated circular plasmid per condition (e.g., plasmid containing H2B-Venus under tubulin promoter).

steps.title: Perform nucleofection
steps.instruction: Insert the sample into the Lonza machine and apply program code EN-138.

steps.title: Recover cells
steps.instruction: Immediately add 80ul of Marine Broth medium (MB) to a well and mix by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Incubate cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cells to 1ml of growth medium in a 12-well plate (NUNC) and incubate overnight.
